# Heterogeneous_3D_Stacking

**Domain**: TCC
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
Vertical stacking of logic, memory, and interconnect chiplets using TSVs (Through-Silicon Vias) to create dense, topology-aware 3D networks. Provides physical layer flexibility for TCC to map non-planar network topologies, improving bandwidth density and energy efficiency.
